items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce | APSB26-153
items.summary: This update addresses multiple critical, high, and medium vulnerabilities, including arbitrary code execution (CVE-2026-103849), privilege escalation, arbitrary file system write, and security feature bypass. Adobe is not aware of any exploits in the wild for these issues.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce | APSB26-138
items.summary: This update resolves critical, important, and moderate vulnerabilities, including security feature bypass and privilege escalation. Eight vulnerabilities are listed, with six exploitable without authentication, including two stored cross-site scripting flaws (CVE-2026-76200, CVE-2026-76201).

items.title: StyleSmuggler: Magento and Adobe Commerce 0-day RCE (CVE-2026-75650)
items.summary: This critical vulnerability, also known as StyleSmuggler, allows unauthenticated attackers to achieve remote code execution by injecting malicious code into Magento's template system. Adobe released an emergency hotfix, and it is being actively exploited in the wild.

items.title: SessionReaper, unauthenticated RCE in Magento & Adobe Commerce
items.summary: A critical flaw allowing customer account takeover and unauthenticated remote code execution under certain conditions. Despite an emergency fix by Adobe in early September 2026, active mass exploitation was observed in October 2026, partly due to Adobe not fully addressing the arbitrary file upload aspect.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce | APSB26-92
items.summary: This update resolves critical, important, and moderate vulnerabilities, including security feature bypass, arbitrary code execution, and privilege escalation. It includes CVE-2026-71362, an Incorrect Authorization vulnerability leading to privilege escalation.
